async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Add Product . . .' button to start adding a new product
    await page.get_by_role("row", name="Manage Products Add Product . . .").get_by_role("button", name="Add Product . . .").click()
    # Wait for the product creation form to load
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    # Fill in product name; assuming a textbox with name 'Product Name'
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Product Name").fill("Energy-Bulk Women Shirt")
    # Fill in price; assuming a textbox with name 'Price'
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Price").fill("60")
    # Set quantity in stock; assuming a textbox with name 'Quantity'
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Quantity").fill("50")
    # Select size S; assuming a combobox with name 'Size'
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option("S")
    # Select color blue; assuming a combobox with name 'Color'
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Color").select_option("blue")
    # Save the product; assuming a button named 'Save'
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    # Wait for save to complete
    await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    # No further actions; the product should be added
    return "Product added successfully"
